info.name: Microsoft Power Apps Microsoft Dataverse Web Accounts Contacts API
Microsoft Power Apps Retrieve Multiple Contacts

params.name: $select
params.description: Comma-separated list of property names to include in the response. Use to limit the properties returned and improve performance.

params.name: $filter
params.description: OData filter expression to restrict the set of records returned. Supports standard OData comparison, logical, and function operators.

params.name: $orderby
params.description: Comma-separated list of properties to sort results by, each optionally followed by asc or desc.

params.name: $top
params.description: Maximum number of records to return.

params.name: $skip
params.description: Number of records to skip before returning results.

params.name: $expand
params.description: Comma-separated list of navigation properties to expand inline in the response. Supports nested $select and $filter on expanded entities.

params.name: $count
params.description: Set to true to include a count of matching records in the response.

items.docs: Retrieves a collection of contact records from Dataverse. Supports OData query options for filtering, sorting, selecting fields, expanding navigation properties, and pagination.

info.name: Microsoft Power Apps Create a New Contact

items.docs: Creates a new contact record in Dataverse. Returns the created record when the Prefer header is set to return=representation.

info.name: Microsoft Power Apps Retrieve a Single Contact

params.name: contactid
params.description: Unique identifier (GUID) of the contact record.

params.name: $select
params.description: Comma-separated list of property names to include in the response. Use to limit the properties returned and improve performance.

params.name: $expand
params.description: Comma-separated list of navigation properties to expand inline in the response. Supports nested $select and $filter on expanded entities.

items.docs: Retrieves a single contact record by its unique identifier.

info.name: Microsoft Power Apps Update an Existing Contact

params.name: contactid
params.description: Unique identifier (GUID) of the contact record.

items.docs: Updates an existing contact record using PATCH (merge update). Only the properties included in the request body are updated.

info.name: Microsoft Power Apps Delete a Contact

params.name: contactid
params.description: Unique identifier (GUID) of the contact record.

items.docs: Deletes an existing contact record from Dataverse.
